narrative.benchmark_md:
Fisher was benchmarked against 5 locked peers within the SV5 (RIA/BD) sub-vertical, selected for AUM proximity, business model overlap, and PE transformation stage: Creative Planning ($390B AUM, E-002), Edelman Financial Engines ($308B AUM, hybrid digital-human), Hightower Advisors ($324B AUM, integrated platform strategy), Mariner Wealth Advisors ($550B AUM, acquisition-led growth), and Mercer Advisors ($90B+ AUM, technology-led differentiation with published AI playbook — E-060, E-066).
Mercer Advisors, despite smaller AUM, sets the technology benchmark with a dedicated CTDO, proprietary platform, and published AI integration playbook. Edelman leads in hybrid digital-human service delivery. Fisher's cloud-native backend likely matches or exceeds most peers in infrastructure maturity, but the client experience gap is the widest in the peer set.

per_pillar_md.P1:
What We See: Fisher has the strategic foundation for transformation: PE mandate with explicit technology focus (E-003, Advent International press release, T3), CEO Damian Ornani leading modernization since 2016 (E-001, SEC Form ADV, T1), and an ESG committee with 6 dedicated specialists managing $26.1B in ESG AUM (E-060, E-061, T3). However, governance is constrained by the 2019 controversy (E-007, ISS-001) and concentrated founder control with Ken Fisher retaining 70%+ voting shares post-PE transaction (E-014, T2). Innovation management lacks structure — no formal innovation program, no patents, no innovation lab (E-010, E-011). By contrast, Mercer Advisors' CTDO role and formal innovation charter demonstrate what structured innovation governance looks like at the peer level. Talent & culture is the critical challenge: GPTW certification and 8-year training MVP coexist with 15-18 month IC turnover (E-006, Glassdoor, T3) and micromanagement themes (E-064, T3).
Why It Matters: P1 scores cap downstream capabilities. (Governance) at 2.18 triggers connected constraints on P3 categories. The culture-innovation tension (training investment vs. turnover) limits Fisher's ability to execute on PE transformation goals without change management intervention. Creative Planning and Mariner Wealth Advisors, both PE-backed, have navigated similar culture transitions through dedicated change management offices (E-023).
